name: dr buzz
tagline: A bot that builds other bots, each scoped to one job and one voice
description: A builder for small, disciplined agents that run on Grok Bot as well as on a Buzz harness. It opens with a short set of questions about how you want the agent to behave, then produces one with a narrow remit, a consistent voice, and any credentials held behind a human approval step rather than used freely.
author: Talal
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
